comments.author: Pope_Shizzle
comments.body_html: Love the mod. Makes ammo storage so very easy. I’ve been using Ammo Generator to generate my own custom ammo. For some reason, even though I can use the new ammo in guns and magazines, I can’t store it in any of the cases this mod creates. Any thoughts as to what the issue may be?

comments.author: Szonszczyk
comments.body_html: Mod is adding ammo to cases based on “Caliber” property that should match this used by other ammo of the same caliber so if you have a mismatch there, it will not be added to the case… or there is a load order issue, but this is unlikely. If you want, you can message me on discord and I will check your AmmoGen files to fix this issue :)
